import ast, collections, copy, datetime, gzip, hashlib, inspect, json, math, re, sys, types, zipfile
from pathlib import Path
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
ROOT = Path.cwd()
DATA = ROOT / "knowledge/experiments/data/2026-10-12-halpern-ipm"
PLAN_SHA = "c28c0ad28ca89dd04887b5033cc07289966afe0e7a9447737b0339317ad831f3"
HELPER_SHA = "547b7d9a9c4c37120f8dbb0fa0b8d0b8b768ff1613d8004869a863a89cd118c3"
def sha(path): return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def load(path, name, expected):
    content = path.read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest() == expected, str(path)
    module = types.ModuleType(name)
    module.__file__ = str(path)
    exec(compile(content, str(path), "exec"), module.__dict__)
    return module
helper = load(DATA / "v54-verify.py", "v56_options_helper", HELPER_SHA)
require, read, flags, close = helper.require, helper.read, helper.flags, helper.close
def exact(a,b): return json.dumps(a,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False)==json.dumps(b,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False)
plan = read(DATA / "v57-plan.json")
require(sha(DATA / "v57-plan.json")==PLAN_SHA, "冻结计划身份")
require(sha(DATA / "ipm-v56-identity.json")==plan["parent_identity_sha256"] and sha(DATA / "v56-verification.json")==plan["evidence_sha256"],"父版与诊断证据")
parent_plan = read(DATA / "v56-plan.json")
require(all(plan[key]==parent_plan[key] for key in ("shared_ipm","highs_reference")), "数值政策未改")
require(all(plan["sets"][key]==parent_plan["sets"][key] for key in ("development","probe","netlib")), "固定模型未改")
require((plan["parent_version"],plan["reference_version"],plan["candidate_version"],plan["reference_objective_scaling"],plan["candidate_objective_scaling"])==(56,56,57,"off","off"), "版本和两侧off")
require((plan["method"],plan["primary_linear_solver"],plan["reference_accuracy"],plan["candidate_accuracy"],plan["time_limit"],plan["wall_timeout"],plan["threads"],plan["seed"],plan["max_iterations"],plan["scaling_passes"])==("homogeneous","normal_cholmod","homogeneous_repair","homogeneous_repair",5,35,1,0,200,5), "共同资源政策")
require((plan["initial_performance_runs"],plan["conditional_full_performance_runs"],plan["gate"]["ctest"])==(102,364,18) and plan["no_model_specific_routing"] is True, "数量和路由约束")

snapshots = {}
for version,item in identities.items():
    require(sha(ROOT / f".tools/solver-ipm-v{version}.exe")==item["solver_sha256"],"真实冻结程序")
    archive_path=DATA / f"ipm-v{version}-source.zip"
    require(sha(archive_path)==item["source_zip_sha256"],"源码包身份")
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as archive:
        names=archive.namelist()
        require(len(names)==len(set(names))==95 and set(names)==set(item["files"]), "95个唯一源码成员")
        snapshots[version]={name:archive.read(name) for name in names}
    require({name:hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() for name,data in snapshots[version].items()}==item["files"],"逐成员来源")
require(sha(ROOT / "build/release/solver.exe")==identity["solver_sha256"]!=parent["solver_sha256"],"实际构建新程序")
require(set(identity["files"])==set(parent["files"]) and len(identity["files"])==95, "95来源集合")
changed_sources=sorted(name for name in identity["files"] if identity["files"][name]!=parent["files"][name])
require(changed_sources==sorted(plan["changed_source_files"])==sorted(["src/normal_cholesky.cpp","src/ipm.cpp"]), "恰2生产源变化")
old,new=snapshots[56]["src/ipm.cpp"],snapshots[57]["src/ipm.cpp"]
require(old.count(b"ipm-cpu-0.46.0")==new.count(b"ipm-cpu-0.47.0")==1 and new.replace(b"ipm-cpu-0.47.0",b"ipm-cpu-0.46.0")==old,"ipm主流程仅版本行变化")
# 逆变换必须逐字恢复v56：只新增固定constexpr与两处条件包装，不改任何浮点表达式或检查。
normal_old=snapshots[56]["src/normal_cholesky.cpp"].decode("utf-8").replace("\r\n","\n")
normal_new=snapshots[57]["src/normal_cholesky.cpp"].decode("utf-8").replace("\r\n","\n")
guard_definition="""constexpr bool bounded_gram_arithmetic =
    std::numeric_limits<double>::is_iec559 && std::numeric_limits<double>::radix == 2 &&
    std::numeric_limits<double>::digits == 53 && std::numeric_limits<double>::max_exponent == 1024 &&
    std::numeric_limits<double>::min_exponent == -1021 && std::numeric_limits<double>::has_denorm == std::denorm_present &&
    std::numeric_limits<long double>::is_iec559 && std::numeric_limits<long double>::radix == 2 &&
    std::numeric_limits<long double>::digits >= 53 &&
    std::numeric_limits<long double>::max_exponent >= 4096 && std::numeric_limits<long double>::min_exponent <= -4096 &&
    contribution_budget <= 8'000'000;
"""
guard_insert="""// 有限 binary64 与正对角的单项约在 2^[-3172,3122]，含舍入的至多八百万项部分和小于 2^3146。
// 仅在上述界位于正常数范围的平台省略逐项重复检查；相消允许为零，最终转换和因子检查仍保留。
"""+guard_definition
require(normal_new.count(guard_insert)==1,"constexpr及说明唯一")
restored=normal_new.replace(guard_insert,"")
for line in ("if (!std::isfinite(contribution) || (a != 0 && b != 0 && contribution == 0)) return false;",
             "if (!std::isfinite(sum)) return false;"):
    wrapped="        if constexpr (!bounded_gram_arithmetic) {\n          "+line+"\n        }"
    require(restored.count(wrapped)==1,"两处检查包装唯一")
    restored=restored.replace(wrapped,"        "+line)
require(restored==normal_old,"除constexpr及两包装外normal源码完整不变")
require(normal_new.count("constexpr Index contribution_budget = 8'000'000;")==1,"累计贡献硬预算仍为800万")
require(plan["trajectory_exclusions"]==["timings","backend_version"],"唯一轨迹排除字段")
platform=read(DATA/"v57-platform-check.json")
require(sha(DATA/"v57-platform-check.json")==identity["platform_check_sha256"],"冻结平台证据身份")
require(platform["passed"] is True and type(platform["returncode"]) is int and platform["returncode"]==0 and
        type(platform["solver_runs"]) is int and platform["solver_runs"]==0 and platform["stderr"]=="","平台实测静态断言通过")
require(platform["compiler_sha256"]==identity["compiler_sha256"] and platform["source_sha256"]==identity["files"]["src/normal_cholesky.cpp"],"平台证明对应真实编译器与当前来源")
require(platform["command"]==[identity["compiler"],"-std=c++20","-x","c++","-fsyntax-only","-"],"平台真实编译命令")
require(platform["source"]=="#include <limits>\nconstexpr long long contribution_budget=8000000;\n"+guard_definition+"static_assert(bounded_gram_arithmetic);\n","证明中的constexpr与实际生产定义逐字一致")
source_proof={"reversible_normal_change":True,"conditional_check_wrappers":2,"floating_point_expressions_unchanged":True,
              "contribution_budget":8000000,"platform_check_sha256":sha(DATA/"v57-platform-check.json"),
              "extra_long_double_iec559_guard":True,"solver_runs":0}

require({name:sha(ROOT/name) for name in identity["files"]}==identity["files"],"95当前来源身份")
require(identity["compiler"]==parent["compiler"] and sha(identity["compiler"])==identity["compiler_sha256"]==parent["compiler_sha256"],"同编译器")
for group,directory in (("libraries",ROOT),("logs",DATA)):
    require({name:sha(directory/name) for name in identity[group]}==identity[group],"实际库与测试日志")
require(len(identity["libraries"])==17 and set(identity["libraries"])==set(parent["libraries"]),"17库集合")
changed_libraries=sorted(name for name in identity["libraries"] if identity["libraries"][name]!=parent["libraries"][name])
require(changed_libraries==["build/release/libsolver_ipm.a","build/release/libsolver_normal_cholesky.a"],"恰2实际库变化")
external={name for name in identity["libraries"] if not Path(name).name.startswith("libsolver_")}
require(len(external)==8 and all(identity["libraries"][name]==parent["libraries"][name] for name in external),"8第三方库完全相同")
parsed=[a or b for a,b in re.findall(r'"([^"\n]+\.a)"|([^\s";]+\.a)(?=\s|$)',identity["link_command"]) if not (a or b).startswith("-")]
require({(ROOT/"build/release"/name).resolve() for name in parsed}=={(ROOT/name).resolve() for name in identity["libraries"]},"真实链接17库")
patch,=helper.strict_json(snapshots[57]["dependencies.lock.json"])["openblas"]["local_patches"]
require(identity["files"][patch["path"]]==patch["sha256"] and sha(ROOT/"build/openblas/openblas-0.3.33/src/solver_openblas_build"/patch["source_file"])==identity["patched_openblas_source_sha256"]==parent["patched_openblas_source_sha256"]==patch["patched_sha256"],"已有BLAS修补来源不变")
for filename,key in (("v57-run.py","runner_sha256"),("v57-freeze.py","freeze_script_sha256"),("v57-runner-self-check.json","runner_self_check_sha256")):
    require(sha(DATA/filename)==identity[key],"冻结工具身份")
require(exact(read(DATA/"v57-runner-self-check.json"),{"passed":True,"command_cases":4,"configuration_cases":2,"gate_cases":11,"trajectory_cases":28,"solver_runs":0}),"真实测前自检")
require(b"100% tests passed out of 18" in (DATA/"iteration-ipm-v57-build.log").read_bytes(),"CTest18")
detail=(DATA/"iteration-ipm-v57-ctest-detail.log").read_bytes()
require(detail.count(b"Test Passed.")==18 and "正规方程 Cholesky 隔离检查通过".encode("utf-8") in detail,"18逐项测试与Gram回归")
input_hashes={}
for stage,count,repeats in (("development",11,3),("probe",6,3),("netlib",91,1)):
    group=plan["sets"][stage]
    path=Path(group["models_file"])
    require(group["repeats"]==repeats and [x["model_index"] for x in group["models"]]==list(range(count)),"输入数量和顺序")
    require(sha(path)==group["models_file_sha256"],"固定模型列表")
    listed=[str((path.parent/line.strip()).resolve()) for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig").splitlines() if line.strip()]
    require(listed==[x["input"] for x in group["models"]] and len(set(listed))==count,"模型列表内容")
    for model in group["models"]:
        if model["input"] not in input_hashes: input_hashes[model["input"]]=sha(model["input"])
        require(model["hash_error"] is None and input_hashes[model["input"]]==model["sha256"],"实际模型身份")
loaded={}
for name in ("benchmark","compare_lp"):
    module=types.ModuleType(name)
    module.__file__=str(ROOT/"scripts"/(name+".py"))
    sys.modules[name]=module
    exec(compile(snapshots[57]["scripts/"+name+".py"],module.__file__,"exec"),module.__dict__)
    loaded[name]=module
benchmark,compare=loaded["benchmark"],loaded["compare_lp"]
runner=load(DATA/"v57-run.py","v56_runner_audit",identity["runner_sha256"])
require(exact(runner.self_check(),read(DATA/"v57-runner-self-check.json")),"冻结runner纯自检复验")
# 从锁定旧核验器中只取逐组核验函数，唯一锚点映射版本/路径和两侧off，不执行旧轮来源检查。
source=(DATA/"v54-verify.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
node=next(x for x in ast.parse(source).body if isinstance(x,ast.FunctionDef) and x.name=="verify_group")
original=ast.get_source_segment(source,node)
adapted=original
changes=[]
def replace(before,after,count=1):
    global adapted
    require(adapted.count(before)==count,"核验复用唯一锚点："+before)
    adapted=adapted.replace(before,after)
    changes.append({"before":before,"after":after,"count":count})
replace('identity = identities[54]','identity = identities[57]')
replace('stem = "v54-" + stage','stem = "v57-" + stage')
replace('candidate = str(ROOT / ".tools/solver-ipm-v54.exe")','candidate = str(ROOT / ".tools/solver-ipm-v57.exe")')
replace('reference_version = 52 if stage == "compatibility" else 54','reference_version = 57 if stage == "highs" else 56')
replace('version = reference_version if index == 0 else 54','version = reference_version if index == 0 else 57')
replace('version = reference_version if side == sides[0] else 54','version = reference_version if side == sides[0] else 57')
replace('if version == 54:','if version in (56, 57):')
replace('if backend == "ipm" and version == 54:','if backend == "ipm" and version in (56, 57):')
before='''    require(":objective_scaling=" not in sides[0] and
            (":objective_scaling=" not in sides[1] if stage == "compatibility" else
             sides[1].endswith(":objective_scaling=off") and sides[1].count(":objective_scaling=") == 1),
            "默认/on标签等价，只有off追加唯一末尾标识")'''
after='''    require(all((":objective_scaling=" not in side if stage == "highs" and index == 0 else
                side.endswith(":objective_scaling=off") and side.count(":objective_scaling=") == 1)
                for index,side in enumerate(sides)), "IPM两侧off标签完整")
    require(all((":binary=" not in side if stage == "highs" else
                side.count(":binary=") == 1 and ":binary=" + ("reference" if index == 0 else "candidate") in side)
                for index,side in enumerate(sides)), "不同程序双侧标签完整")'''
replace(before,after)
def objective_mode(stage,reference): return None if stage=="highs" and reference else "off"
def verify_options(report,frozen,backend,version,mode):
    copied=copy.deepcopy(report)
    if backend=="ipm":
        require(report["backend_version"]==("ipm-cpu-0.46.0" if version==56 else "ipm-cpu-0.47.0"),"真实本侧IPM版本")
        require(type(report["options"]["ipm"]["objective_scaling"]) is bool and report["options"]["ipm"]["objective_scaling"] is False,"实际off布尔")
        copied["backend_version"]="ipm-cpu-0.45.0"
    helper.verify_options(copied,frozen,backend,54,mode)
    if backend=="highs":
        require(report["backend_version"]=="1.15.1","实际HiGHS版本")
namespace=dict(vars(helper))
namespace.update(PLAN_SHA=PLAN_SHA,verify_options=verify_options,objective_mode=objective_mode)
exec(compile(adapted,"<v57-复用逐组核验>","exec"),namespace)
group_audit=namespace["verify_group"]
ALLOWED_STATUSES={"optimal","infeasible","unbounded","infeasible_or_unbounded","empty","time_limit","iteration_limit",
    "solution_limit","objective_bound","objective_target","interrupted","memory_limit","unknown","error","numerical_error","verification_failed"}
def trajectory(group):
    manifest,_,rows=group
    sides=(manifest["reference_variant"],manifest["candidate_variant"])
    pairs=collections.defaultdict(dict)
    for row in rows:
        key=(row["input"],row["repetition"]); side=row["requested_variant"]
        require(side in sides and side not in pairs[key],"独立轨迹对子唯一")
        pairs[key][side]=row
    result={"pairs":len(pairs),"equal":0,"budget_limited":0,"invalid":0,"different":0}
    for pair in pairs.values():
        require(set(pair)==set(sides),"独立轨迹完整双侧")
        a,b=(pair[side] for side in sides)
        valid=True
        for row in (a,b):
            report=row.get("report")
            valid=valid and helper.valid_process_report(row,benchmark.classify(row["returncode"],report))
            if not isinstance(report,dict):
                valid=False;continue
            timings=report.get("timings")
            valid=valid and report.get("status") in ALLOWED_STATUSES and isinstance(timings,dict)
            if isinstance(timings,dict):
                valid=valid and all(helper.finite(timings.get(key)) and timings[key]>=0
                    for key in ("read_seconds","solve_seconds","verification_seconds","total_seconds"))
            valid=valid and helper.finite(row.get("elapsed_wall_seconds")) and row["elapsed_wall_seconds"]>0
        if not valid:
            result["invalid"]+=1;continue
        if any(row["report"]["status"]=="time_limit" or row["report"]["timings"]["solve_seconds"]+
               row["report"]["timings"]["verification_seconds"]>5 or row["elapsed_wall_seconds"]>35 for row in (a,b)):
            result["budget_limited"]+=1;continue
        normalized=copy.deepcopy([a["report"],b["report"]])
        for report in normalized:
            del report["timings"]
            del report["backend_version"]
        result["equal" if exact(normalized[0],normalized[1]) and a["returncode"]==b["returncode"] else "different"]+=1
    result["passed"]=result["invalid"]==result["different"]==0
    return result
def trajectory_selfcheck():
    rows=[{"input":"synthetic","repetition":0,"requested_variant":side,"returncode":4,"error":None,"elapsed_wall_seconds":2,
        "report":{"schema_version":1,"status":"numerical_error","backend_version":side,"iterations":2,
            "timings":{"read_seconds":0,"solve_seconds":1,"verification_seconds":0,"total_seconds":1}}} for side in ("r","c")]
    manifest={"reference_variant":"r","candidate_variant":"c"}
    count=0
    def check(value,category):
        nonlocal count
        audit=trajectory((manifest,None,value))
        require(audit[category]==1 and audit["passed"] is (category in ("equal","budget_limited")),"独立轨迹合成门槛")
        count+=1
    check(rows,"equal")
    changed=copy.deepcopy(rows);changed[1]["report"]["iterations"]=3;check(changed,"different")
    changed[1]["report"]["timings"]["solve_seconds"]=6;check(changed,"budget_limited")
    for mutate in (
        lambda r:r.update(report=None),
        lambda r:r.update(returncode=3221225477),
        lambda r:r.update(returncode=True),
        lambda r:r.update(error="wall_timeout"),
        lambda r:r["report"].update(status="bogus"),
        lambda r:r["report"]["timings"].update(solve_seconds=True),
        lambda r:r["report"]["timings"].pop("total_seconds")):
        changed=copy.deepcopy(rows);changed[0]["report"]["status"]="time_limit"
        mutate(changed[1]);check(changed,"invalid")
    changed=copy.deepcopy(rows);changed[0]["report"]["extra"]=False;changed[1]["report"]["extra"]=0;check(changed,"different")
    return {"passed":True,"cases":count,"solver_runs":0}
trajectory_checks=trajectory_selfcheck()

groups={}
stage_results={}
def audit_stage(stage):
    group=group_audit(stage,identities,plan,benchmark,compare)
    manifest,summary,rows=group
    require(exact(group,runner.archive(stage)),"冻结runner归档与独立核验一致")
    invalid=[]; missing=[]; failed=[]
    for row in rows:
        valid=helper.valid_process_report(row,benchmark.classify(row["returncode"],row["report"])) and (row["report"] or {}).get("status") in ALLOWED_STATUSES
        brief={key:row[key] for key in ("run_index","input","requested_variant","returncode","classification","quality_failure")}
        if not valid:
            invalid.append(brief)
            require(row["quality_pass"] is False and row["quality_penalized_wall_seconds"]==35 and row["quality_penalized_numerical_seconds"]==5,"无效进程必须完整罚分")
        if row["report"] is None: missing.append(brief)
        else:
            require(all(helper.finite(row["report"]["timings"].get(k)) and row["report"]["timings"][k]>=0 for k in ("read_seconds","solve_seconds","verification_seconds","total_seconds")),"所有报告四计时有限")
        if not row["quality_pass"]: failed.append(brief)
    stage_results[stage]={"runs":len(rows),"reference_variant":manifest["reference_variant"],"candidate_variant":manifest["candidate_variant"],
        "variants":summary["variants"],"both_variants_all_repeats_pass_count":summary["both_variants_all_repeats_pass_count"],
        "missing_reports":missing,"invalid_process_reports":invalid,"failed_runs":failed,
        "artifacts":{suffix:sha(DATA/("v57-"+stage+suffix)) for suffix in ("-manifest.json","-summary.json","-runs.jsonl.gz","-command.json","-process.json","-run.log")}}
    groups[stage]=group
audit_stage("development")
audit_stage("probe")
def differences(stage):
    manifest,_,rows=groups[stage]
    sides=(manifest["reference_variant"],manifest["candidate_variant"])
    counts={model["input"]:[0,0] for model in plan["sets"][stage]["models"]}
    for row in rows: counts[row["input"]][sides.index(row["requested_variant"])]+=int(row["quality_pass"])
    return ([Path(k).stem for k,v in counts.items() if v[1]<v[0]],
            [Path(k).stem for k,v in counts.items() if v[1]>v[0]])
def sgm(stage,side,kind):
    rows=[r for r in groups[stage][2] if r["requested_variant"]==side]
    return math.expm1(sum(math.log1p(r["quality_penalized_"+kind+"_seconds"]/10) for r in rows)/len(rows))*10
dev_lost,_=differences("development"); probe_lost,probe_gain=differences("probe")
dm=groups["development"][0]; dr,dc=dm["reference_variant"],dm["candidate_variant"]
speed=sgm("development",dc,"numerical")<sgm("development",dr,"numerical") and sgm("development",dc,"wall")<=sgm("development",dr,"wall")

    if netlib_trajectory["passed"]:

else:
    for stage in ("netlib","highs"):

count=sum(len(x[2]) for x in groups.values())
expected_count=102 if not gate["eligible_for_netlib"] else 466 if netlib_trajectory["passed"] else 284
require(count==expected_count,"102/284/466事前数量完整保留")
